`final class VideoAudioPlayer`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.video` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [VideoAudioPlayer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/video/VideoAudioPlayer.java)

Plays the sound of one video through the audio bridge, in step with its frames.

## Description

Each [`VideoResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/videoresourcedecoder/) creates its own when the video has sound and an audio bridge is registered; you only call `audioListenerPosition`.
The volume is the volume of the video times 0.3, and with a location, times the falloff of the distance to the listener.

## Method details

<a id="VideoAudioPlayer-method-audioListenerPosition"></a>

### audioListenerPosition

`void audioListenerPosition(AudioListenerPosition audioListenerPosition)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Sets where the listener stands for every video placed with a location, such as the camera of your scene; `null` puts it at `(0, 0, 0)`.
Set it back to `null` when the screen that set it closes.
